jobs.description:
Job Description

Dewberry is currently seeking a Geospatial Analyst
II
in our Tampa, FL or Fairfax, VA
offices. Remote positions
will be considered dependent on experience. This is an excellent career opportunity for an individual to join a team of professionals while working in a multidisciplinary consulting and engineering firm. The firm succeeds through the individual and collaborative skills of its people therefore we offer opportunities for professional growth while working with and applying the latest technology. Typical responsibilities are to work on Remote Sensing related projects for state and federal clients across the US.

Dewberry is a leading, market-facing professional services firm with more than 60 locations and 2,500 professionals nationwide. What sets us apart from our competitors is our people. At Dewberry, we seek out exceptional talent and strive to deliver the highest quality of services to our clients. Whether you’re an experienced professional or a new graduate, you’ll have the chance to collaborate with the best and brightest and work on innovative and complex projects at the forefront of the industry. Our commitment to excellence stems from our personal integrity and from other defining attributes, which we call “Dewberry at Work,” that have inspired our employees to be successful for more than a half-century.

Responsibilities

Position requires experience in analysis and review of topographic lidar data, vector data (2D and 3D), Digital Elevation Models (DEMs), Digital Surface Models (DSMs), and derivative products for state, federal, and private clients across the US. Experience with creating automated lidar classification algorithms (TerraSolid Products) required. Strong candidates will also have a good, conceptual understanding of fundamental remote sensing concepts and geospatial processes for various products, e.g. how lidar sensors work, basic GPS ground survey procedures, airborne lidar trajectory processing, interaction of light and water for bathymetry applications, and ortho-imagery processing.

Working with the initial processing and data classification of multiple topographic and/or bathymetric lidar projects.
Creating Scripts/Models/Macros in multiple sensor platforms.
Perform initial classification of point clouds, including initial grounding, building routines, vegetation classification, and other point cloud filtering.
Performing relative and absolute adjustments to lidar data (calibration/alignment/registration).
Perform QAQC on initially processed data to ensure it meets rigorous accuracy and qualitative requirements.
Create a variety of digital mapping/remotely sensed products using various software platforms;
Work with the Product Line Lead to assist in the execution of projects, on time and within budget.
Perform work that appropriately follows all quality control steps and practices are implemented throughout processes to ensure deliverables meet client specifications.
Support improvements to automation of the production and QC process.
Task Management; Problem resolution; Report writing; Collaboration.

Required Skills & Required Experience

Required Skills and Experience

Bachelor's degree in Geography, GIS, or related field.
3+ years of experience in the GIS/Remote Sensing Field or equivalent combination of education and experience.
Experience in elevation data processing and elevation model creation/manipulation, hydrography, or other remote sensing processing, development, and QA/QC.
An understanding of GIS, elevation data, lidar, and concepts including a strong knowledge of various raster and vector data types, coordinate systems, projections, and datums.
In-depth knowledge of ESRI’s products including ArcGIS 10x, ArcPro, and experience with GDBs.
Proficiency in basic computer applications, especially MS Office (Word, Excel, and Access).
Ability to handle multiple priorities under tight schedules as required.
Strong verbal and written communication skills.

Beneficial Skills & Experience

Understanding of Lidar production workflow and being able to explain the conceptual basis of Lidar acquisition, processing, and deliverable creation.
The ability to analyze point clouds and various geospatial data layers derived from point cloud data.
Experience performing lidar swath line to line calibration in one of the following software: Bayes Strip Align, Terrasolid Terramatch, or Teledyne Optech Lidar Mapping Suite (LMS).
Creative problem-solving skills.
GISP Certification, ASPRS certifications in Lidar or other Remote Sensing technologies a plus.
Working knowledge of Python and/or other programming languages a plus.
GDAL Tools, and command line applications highly desirable.
ArcGIS Data Review and Production Editing experience a plus.
Specific experience working with the retired National Hydrography Dataset (NHD), USGS 3DHP, or other hydrology data.
Experience in hydrography, H&H modeling, flood mapping or related area.
Experience creating scripts/models/macros in multiple GIS/remote sensing platforms.
Experience with national elevation programs, such as NOAA’s Coastal Mapping Program, USGS 3DEP, and/or USGS 3DHP.
Experience with industry standards and specifications, e.g., Elevation-Derived Hydrography Data Acquisition Specifications, Elevation-Derived Hydrography – READ Rules, ASPRS Positional accuracy Standards for Digital Geospatial Data, USGS Lidar Base Specifications.

Position Description

Seattle Public Utilities (SPU) is looking for a motivated, detail-driven Environmental Compliance Inspector
, under the city of Seattle job classification of ( Civil Engineer, Specialist Associate

In this role, you’ll make a real impact by protecting our wastewater infrastructure, supporting sustainable practices, and helping local businesses and residents understand how they can contribute to a cleaner, healthier city.

In this role, you will use your engineering mindset to:

Assess and enforce compliance with the City’s Fats, Oils, and Grease (FOG) program to protect pipe integrity and prevent system failures.
Investigate sewer-related issues, applying problem-solving and analytical skills to identify root causes and recommend corrective actions.
Conduct outreach to businesses and residents, helping them understand how small changes can prevent costly infrastructure damage.
Respond to environmental incidents to safeguard public health and minimize impacts on wastewater and stormwater systems.

About Seattle Public Utilities:
Seattle Public Utilities (SPU) is a community-centered utility that delivers vital services to Seattle residents and businesses including drinking water, drainage and wastewater, and garbage/recycling/compost. SPU also provides drinking water for 1.5 million customers in the region. SPU’s work includes system maintenance and improvements and keeping Seattle clean. Over 1,400 SPU employees work with our community to provide affordable and equitable stewardship of our water and waste resources for future generations.

For more information about Seattle Public Utilities (SPU), check out the:

SPU Website
SPU Workplace Expectations(Download PDF reader)
Strategic Business Plan

SPU commits to Our City Values and Race and Social Justice as core principles that guide our work. We actively take steps to dismantle systemic racism and increase service equity. We value diverse life experiences and strive to create a workplace that is welcoming to all. We take steps to be inclusive and equitable in our recruiting, hiring and promotional opportunities.

Why join us?

About

We know work isn't only about what you do it’s also about who you work for and with! SPU provides a fun and family-friendly work environment that supports a work life balance, including:

Family-friendly and multicultural work environment
Generous benefits package

Are you an experienced environmental due diligence consultant, skilled in uncovering environmental risks and turning technical findings into clear, actionable advice for decision-makers? Do you enjoy working across EHS and ESG topics to help shape sustainable outcomes for transactions and post-acquisition strategies? Are you a detail-focused communicator who thrives on fast-paced due diligence work, site visits, and collaborative problem-solving?

If this sounds like you, then this role could be the perfect opportunity. Join our CST Due Diligence UK & Ireland team as our new Experienced Senior Consultant Environmental Due Diligence and work with us to close the gap to a sustainable future.

Your new role

As an Experienced Senior Consultant Environmental Due Diligence, you will be part of our busy UK transactions team supporting fast-paced UK and global M&A transactions. You will assist with the identification of key EHS and ESG risks and opportunities and provide high-quality, targeted advice to clients on both buy-side and sell-side due diligence projects

Our team advises on transactions across a wide range of sectors, typically including industrial, commercial and infrastructure assets and businesses, often for finance sector clients. We work closely with in-house specialists across several EHS and ESG disciplines to provide targeted due diligence advice. Our clients use this advice to support negotiations during the bidding process and o to make informed impactful decisions on sustainability priorities post-acquisition. 

You will play a key role in the team, principally delivering due diligence assessments, while also supporting project management and the development of client proposals. 

Your key responsibilities will be:

Preparation of proposals, including pricing/budgets and timescales. Participation in client discussions and support with developing new client relationships.
Project Management and coordination of medium to large projects including multi-site projects over several geographies in support of buy-side and sell-side due diligence.
Delivery of Phase I Environmental Site Assessments and Limited Environmental Compliance Review(LECR) assessments for a range of sites, including more complex manufacturing facilities; including participation in management calls, interpreting available information and preparing focussed client reports. 
Delivery of Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) assessments of companies in support of buy-side and sell-side due diligence. This will include desk-based research (review of data rooms and publicly available information), participation in management calls, interpreting available information and preparing client focussed reports.

About You

If you have relevant EHS/ESG knowledge, experience in due diligence and want to advance your career in a collaborative team, we would like to hear from you.What matters most to us:

Relevant degree/qualifications. Ideally in environmental studies/geography or similar.
Sound understanding of UK environmental regulations and an understanding of key environmental and sustainability regulations in Europe.
7 to 12 years of practical work experience in other companies where you have personally been involved in the delivery of Phase I Environmental Site Assessments, LECR assessments, ideally including to ASTM standards, and ideally also ESG assessments. Have the ability to understand information quickly and work efficiently, proactively and autonomously.
Experience in supporting the preparation of proposals.  
Strong communication skills (both written and verbal), and be comfortable engaging with external clients and advisors.
Project Management experience.
A collaborative approach and willingness to travel, typically within the UK and Ireland.

What We Can Offer You

Commitment to your development
Leaders guided by our Leadership Principles
A culture that welcomes you as the unique person you are
Inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects
The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company
Flexible work environment
27 days annual leave plus bank holidays

Private medical cover and life assurance

Erfaring med organisationsudvikling er en klar fordel, fordi fagområderne er under konstant udvikling, og organisationen løbende skal tilpasses opgaverne.

Teknisk indsigt i luftforsvars- eller dronesystemer er en fordel og ikke et krav.

Du skal kunne opbygge samarbejdsrelationer på tværs af hele koncernen, og som chef skal du gå forrest og skabe følgeskab i en tid, hvor der stilles ekstraordinære høje krav til din organisation.

Er det dig?

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår forhandles efter rammeaftalen om kontraktansættelse af chefer i staten. Den endelige lønpakke vil afhænge af din baggrund og dine kvalifikationer, men stillingen er indplaceret i løngruppe 1.

Derudover er der mulighed for at forhandle tillæg efter kvalifikationer, ligesom der er mulighed for, at ansættelse kan ske ved konstitution. Der er til stillingen knyttet en arbejdsgiverfinansieret pension.

Hvis du i forvejen er tjenestemand, er der mulighed for, at ansættelsen kan ske som tjenestemand i lønramme 37 efter en konkret vurdering. Ansøgningen skal stiles til Kongen, medmindre du allerede er indplaceret i lønramme 37.

Vi arbejder for at sikre, at det samlede forsvar er udstyret, opdateret og operativt, i en tid, hvor kravene til hastighed og kampkraft aldrig har været større. Vi er en mangfoldig organisation med ca. 2.500 medarbejdere, civile og militære, fordelt ud over hele Kongeriget.

Vi køber, implementerer, opdaterer og drifter systemerne og følger dem hele vejen fra operativt behov til virkende kapacitet.

Det kræver, at teknik, operativ forståelse og kommerciel indsigt spiller sammen, og at vi arbejder tæt sammen med brugerne i alle værn, tekniske fagmiljøer, leverandører, industrien og internationale partnere i blandt andet NATO, Norden og EU.

Som chef får du det samlede ansvar for udviklingen af forretningsområdet for UAS og Counter UAS. Disse områder er konstant under udvikling og hænger i stigende grad sammen, og skal derfor udvikles i sammenhæng.

Lede drift og udvikling af eksisterende kapaciteter.
Sikre anskaffelse, implementering og løbende opdatering af nye droner og dronebaserede Counter UAS-kapaciteter.
Være projektejer ved materielanskaffelser inden for ansvarsområdet og følge dem fra operativt behov til leveret og virkende kapacitet.

Du kan komme fra Forsvaret, industrien, en anden styrelse eller et andet teknologitungt miljø. Du prioriterer ledelse, men har lyst til at gå nysgerrigt ind i teknologien, sammen med dine specialister. Du kommunikerer klart på dansk og engelsk og er vant til at sikre et højt niveau af skriftlighed.

Teknisk indsigt i luftforsvars- eller dronesystemer er en fordel og ikke et krav.

Du skal kunne opbygge samarbejdsrelationer på tværs af hele koncernen, og som chef skal du gå forrest og skabe følgeskab i en tid, hvor der stilles ekstraordinære høje krav til din organisation.

Er det dig?

Ansættelsesvilkår

Løn- og ansættelsesvilkår forhandles efter rammeaftalen om kontraktansættelse af chefer i staten. Den endelige lønpakke vil afhænge af din baggrund og dine kvalifikationer, men stillingen er indplaceret i løngruppe 1.

Derudover er der mulighed for at forhandle tillæg efter kvalifikationer, ligesom der er mulighed for, at ansættelse kan ske ved konstitution. Der er til stillingen knyttet en arbejdsgiverfinansieret pension.

Hvis du i forvejen er tjenestemand, er der mulighed for, at ansættelsen kan ske som tjenestemand i lønramme 37 efter en konkret vurdering. Ansøgningen skal stiles til Kongen, medmindre du allerede er indplaceret i lønramme 37.

Som ansat under Forsvarsministeriet er du omfattet af nogle særlige vilkår. Det betyder blandt andet, at du skal kunne sikkerhedsgodkendes og opretholde denne i hele din ansættelsesperiode.

Du har som ansat pligt til at forrette tjeneste uden for landets grænser, herunder ved enheder i internationale operationer med henblik på deltagelse i konfliktforebyggende, fredsbevarende, fredsskabende, humanitære og andre lignende operationer.

Såfremt du er M331 og skal udnævnes til stillingen, skal du som udgangspunkt have helbredsvurdering C. Ligeledes bedes du vedlægge dine seneste tre FOKUS-bedømmelser.

Har du spørgsmål til løn- og ansættelsesvilkår, er du velkommen til at kontakte Personelkommandoen, HR-konsulent K. Anton Nyholm på tlf. 61 40 74 92.

Ansøgningsfristen er d. 11. oktober 2026 og samtaler forventes afholdt i forlængelse heraf.

Stillingen er til besættelse 01. januar 2027.
